verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI supports deep/BFS crawling with a max-pages limit and a new prefetch=True mode explicitly for '5-10x faster URL discovery,' suggesting URL-only discovery without full content extraction. However, there's no dedicated sitemap/URL-listing feature or clear documentation of a lightweight 'discover all URLs' mode distinct from crawling, so it requires configuring crawl parameters rather than a purpose-built instant discovery tool.
